The blood test that looks at your average sugar over the last three months is called HbA1c. Yours was six point one. Anything under five point seven is normal, and anything over six and a half is diabetes. Yours is between the two, in what we call the pre-diabetes range (certainty=provisional, basis=HbA1c 6.1, pre-diabetes range, stated_by=doctor)
